effects.notes: Immediately on play, the owner gains 1 wood.

In the field phase of each harvest, the owner may use this card to hand over exactly 1 wood and 1 food for 1 bonus point. The trigger fires once per harvest field phase, so at most one exchange per harvest; both sources price it at exactly wood 1 plus food 1.

review.notes: Cost: none. Prereq: none. Printed points: 0. Ban: none. Own-word summary of the third-party wiki effect: on play the owner immediately gains 1 wood, and in each harvest's field phase the owner may trade exactly 1 wood plus 1 food for 1 bonus point through this card. Classification (docs/all-cards-classification-final.md, PR #377 source): stage 4, P1 on-play plus repeated harvest field-phase trigger (TR-SITE, STACK; recorded as already gated by PR #356 G0+G1).
